instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. On a dirt path in a wooded park, the man in the blue short-sleeved shirt (R1) and the woman in the grey blazer (R2) walk closely side-by-side. The man (R1) on the left looks down with a gentle smile, while the woman (R2) on the right looks forward. Her right arm is linked through his left arm as they stroll. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a warm, peaceful atmosphere.
